# orion log

Add to the canvas log, and list it

```sh
orion log <command> [options]
```

## orion log add

Log what happened, optionally attached to cards. Corrections are new entries.

```sh
orion log add [options] <text...>
```

| Argument          | Description                                        |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `<text...>`       | **Required.** What happened                        |
| `--card <value>`  | Card ids to attach the entry to, comma-separated   |
| `--agent <value>` | Log as this agent. Without it, the entry is by you |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                         |

## orion log list

List the canvas log, newest first

```sh
orion log list [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                  |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `--card <value>`  | Only entries attached to this card           |
| `--limit <value>` | Show at most this many of the newest entries |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                   |
